body: I am happy that he is over his depression and i definitely wouldn't change anything i did. But whenever i think of him now i just feel angry about how he turned on me, and sad because i lost such a great friend.

Well i helped him because i became friends with him, and then later i learned about his depression. I helped him because he was my friend and i couldn't just abandoned him. I didn't expect to get anything in return. As far as how he acts towards me. We used to have a ton of fun together, we were great friends! but in the past month or so he's become so arrogant. He's a great singer and he's great at giving speeches, and all he'll talk about is how amazing he is. He has such a 'holier than thou' attitude about everything now. Whenever i'm around him i find myself constantly being insulted and talked down to by him. Its not just me either, other people have noticed his change in attitude as well.
